question.text: A PM can lend securities held on behalf of clients:

answer.text: Only as provided under SEBI (PM) Regulations

explanation.text: The Logic: Lending is allowed only as per SEBI (PM) Regs; otherwise prohibited. The Trap: Free or unregulated lending breaches rules. Cross-Exam Context: Same in III-C. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Securities lending and borrowing via exchange SLB platform is the compliant route.
